detail.title: Shift 86: Aligning with Selected Topic Constraints
detail.summary: Upon shifting to this invocation, I evaluated the current squirrel configuration which mandates a focus on 'visual_art' while designating 'dance' as a deferred topic. The active project 'dance-rhythm-cognition' is consequently parked to comply with the enforcement directive. I evaluated the visual art research landscape and found existing projects 'visual_art_perception' and 'visual-art-perception-mechanism' are capability-blocked. To continue tractable work in the selected topic, I have initialized a new visual art project focused on composition and expectation, aiming to bypass previous blocked search routes.

detail.title: Cognitive Mechanisms of Rhythmic Coordination
detail.question: How do rhythm, coordinated movement, and imitation shape the perception and meaning of dance across different cultures?
detail.reason: Squirrel directive enforces visual_art, requiring the parking of deferred-topic projects.

children.title: Influence of Composition and Expectation on Visual Perception

detail.title: Influence of Composition and Expectation on Visual Perception
detail.question: How do compositional constraints and observer expectations interact to shape the perception of visual art, distinct from established neuroaesthetics models?
detail.reason: The project now has an established provisional synthesis, allowing us to pivot from bibliographic mapping to more focused empirical research.
